site.name: Frost Guide
site.headline:
Find your way
through the frost.
site.intro: Your field notes for Whiteout Survival. From city building to alliance teamwork, make every decision with a little more preparation.
site.about: Your field notes for city development, hero growth and alliance teamwork. Some guides are sample notes; follow the latest in-game information for exact values, unlock requirements and event rules.

guides.title: Daily login essentials
guides.summary: A 12-part daily routine for free-to-play, light-spending and casual players: rewards, merchants, marches and queues.
guides.note: Intel refresh times retain the original UTC schedule with Taiwan time (UTC+8) reference. Other daily guidance was provided by the player.

sections.heading: Purpose and audience
sections.body: For free-to-play, light-spending and casual players. Make the most of daily login time without wasting free rewards, march slots, resources or available attempts.

sections.heading: 01 ◷ Intel missions

table.caption: Intel refresh times: UTC and Taiwan

sections.body: Intel refreshes 3 times a day, every 8 hours. Complete intel missions promptly after each refresh to avoid excessive accumulation or missed rewards.

checklist.label: Review unfinished tasks
checklist.detail: Check resource gathering, troop training, arena challenges and other daily activity objectives.

checklist.label: Claim activity rewards
checklist.detail: Complete daily activity and claim all available rewards.

table.caption: Mystery Merchant and Wandering Merchant
rows: Use all daily free refreshes and claim free items first.
Mystery Coins are hard to obtain. Save them for rare items such as hero exclusive weapons; prioritize related items at 50% off.
For each of the 6 item slots, keep buying with ordinary resources until its price changes to gems. Do not buy at the gem price.
Only refresh after all 6 slots have changed to gem prices. Repeat this purchase-and-refresh cycle until no refreshes remain.

checklist.label: Mystery Merchant · Purpose
checklist.detail: Spend scarce Mystery Coins on hard-to-obtain items, such as hero exclusive weapons.

checklist.label: Wandering Merchant · Purpose
checklist.detail: Use ordinary resources to obtain speedups and teleport items. Stop buying once prices switch to gems; do not spend gems to clear the shop.

checklist.label: Login rewards and packs
checklist.detail: Check daily login rewards and free packs.

checklist.label: Alliance and events
checklist.detail: Collect alliance gifts and event rewards.

checklist.label: Other free items
checklist.detail: Confirm all available free rewards have been claimed.

checklist.label: Building upgrades
checklist.detail: Check for idle building queues and keep them running where possible.

checklist.label: Troop training or promotion
checklist.detail: Schedule training or promotions to avoid long idle periods.

checklist.label: Technology research
checklist.detail: Check that research is ongoing. When preparing for a major event, reserve speedups and resources as needed.

sections.heading: 06 ⚑ Gathering marches

table.caption: Keep 1 march for auto-joining rallies; gather with the rest

sections.body: Send gathering marches before logging off to avoid idle slots. Adjust for alliance events or combat when needed.

checklist.label: Check accumulated patrols
checklist.detail: Review the accumulated patrol count regularly.

checklist.label: Aim to stay at 80 or below
checklist.detail: Complete patrols in time to avoid missing available rewards.

checklist.label: Complete 10 rally rewards daily
checklist.detail: Confirm all daily rally rewards have been collected.

checklist.label: Starting a rally: prioritize Gina
checklist.detail: Use Gina when starting applicable wilderness rallies to benefit from reduced stamina consumption.

checklist.label: Joining a rally: Gina is not always needed
checklist.detail: Starting and joining are different actions. Auto-join can reduce manual work; normally keep 1 march available to support auto-rallies.

checklist.label: 4 dispatches per day
checklist.detail: Check and perform all 4 daily pet dispatches.

checklist.label: Claim completed rewards
checklist.detail: Remember to collect rewards when dispatches finish.

checklist.label: Visit and collect regularly
checklist.detail: Collect produced resources and available rewards.

checklist.label: Check available actions
checklist.detail: Review other actions you can perform on the island.

checklist.label: Watch accumulated online time
checklist.detail: Claim rewards when their time requirements are met.

checklist.label: Review daily collection
checklist.detail: Confirm all currently available daily online rewards are claimed.

checklist.label: Intel and activity
checklist.detail: Complete intel missions and claim daily activity rewards.

checklist.label: Building, training and research
checklist.detail: Check that queues are still running.

checklist.label: Gathering and auto-rallies
checklist.detail: Send gathering marches and reserve an auto-rally march.

checklist.label: Free rewards
checklist.detail: Claim all available free rewards.

checklist.label: Other daily checks
checklist.detail: Review pet dispatches, expert patrols and Daybreak Island.

guides.title: Bear attack: a three-step visual guide
guides.summary: Three sample illustrations with step-by-step notes. Replace them with your own screenshots and verified instructions.

sections.heading: Step 1: Prepare your team
sections.alt: A sample illustration of winter survivors preparing their equipment
sections.caption: Demo illustration · not a game screenshot
sections.body: Review your team before the event. This placeholder shows generic survivors and equipment, not a recommended hero lineup. Replace it with your own team screenshot and instructions.

sections.heading: Step 2: Assemble the rally
sections.alt: A sample illustration of winter squads gathering by a rally flag
sections.caption: Demo illustration · not a game screenshot
sections.body: Check your alliance announcement and in-game event instructions before participating. This illustration demonstrates where a rally screenshot can go; it does not show actual game controls.

sections.heading: Step 3: Attack and review the results
sections.alt: A sample illustration of a bear and winter squads in a snowy arena
sections.caption: Demo illustration · not a game screenshot
sections.body: Follow the current event rules and alliance plan, then review the results. Replace this test image with your own battle screenshot and add the relevant explanation.

guides.title: Furnace and city: your upgrade checklist
guides.summary: Check prerequisites and resources first, then develop your city at a pace that suits you.

sections.heading: Check prerequisites
sections.body: Review the buildings, resources and time required in the upgrade interface. List any missing requirements and complete the ones blocking progress first.

sections.heading: Plan resources and queues
sections.body: Arrange gathering and construction based on your actual needs. Check storage protection and available resources before claiming large amounts you cannot use immediately.

sections.heading: Check survivor status
sections.body: As your city grows, review survivor needs and the facilities that support them. Follow in-game information for exact effects and mechanics.

guides.title: Hero growth: spend resources with purpose
guides.summary: Review hero roles and training priorities to create a manageable development plan.

sections.heading: Read skills and roles first
sections.body: Review each hero’s skills, troop type and supported modes. Battles, exploration and other activities may call for different choices; do not rely on one number alone.

sections.heading: Plan around your current heroes
sections.body: Take stock of your heroes and materials, then prioritize the teams you use most. Check the purpose and sources of rare shards and equipment before spending them.

sections.heading: Keep notes from actual play
sections.body: Record how teams perform in comparable situations before making changes. These notes do not provide unverified rankings or a fixed best team.

guides.title: Resource management: prepare for your next build
guides.summary: Review resource sources, requirements and items to make your upgrade plan clearer.

sections.heading: Review your current needs
sections.body: Decide on your next construction or research goal, then identify the resources you lack. Avoid using all your items before you have a clear goal.

sections.heading: Check resource sources
sections.body: Use in-game source information to find tasks, gathering and other ways to obtain resources. Plan around the features you have unlocked.

sections.heading: Use items when you need them
sections.body: Time resource-item use around your next objective. Read item descriptions and protection rules; this sample is not a fixed strategy.

guides.title: State Transfer guide
guides.summary: Prepare Transfer Passes, contact your destination and review eligibility, transfer steps and important limits.
guides.note: Reminder: transfer eligibility and event rules are subject to the current in-game announcement.

checklist.label: 1. Check the transfer range
checklist.detail: Confirm the destination state is within the eligible range for this event.

checklist.label: 2. Check the power limit
checklist.detail: Make sure your power meets the destination state’s limit.

checklist.label: 3. Prepare Transfer Passes
checklist.detail: Prepare enough Transfer Passes.

checklist.label: 4. Contact the destination state
checklist.detail: Ask in advance whether places are available.

checklist.label: 5. Check eligibility and cooldown
checklist.detail: Confirm you meet transfer eligibility and cooldown requirements.

table.caption: Ways to obtain Transfer Passes
rows: Usually 1 pass per week for 150,000 alliance coins.
Passes can also be purchased through packs.

checklist.label: 1. Open the event
checklist.detail: Open the State Transfer event.

checklist.label: 2. Choose a destination
checklist.detail: Select the state you want to move to.

checklist.label: 3. Review requirements
checklist.detail: Check the power limit, required Transfer Passes and remaining places.

checklist.label: 4. Check the transfer phase
checklist.detail: Accept an invitation during the invitation phase, or wait for the free transfer phase.

checklist.label: 5. Leave and recall
checklist.detail: Leave your current alliance and recall all deployed troops.

checklist.label: 6. Confirm your transfer
checklist.detail: Select Transfer and confirm to move to the new state.

table.caption: Read before transferring
rows: You may need a special invitation from the destination state.
An invitation does not waive the Transfer Pass requirement.
Unprotected resources exceeding warehouse protection may be removed.
Free transfer places are limited. Contact the destination state in advance.
You usually need to wait 25 days after transferring before you can transfer again.
Each player must meet the requirements and prepare their own Transfer Passes.
